title.narrative: Policy 1 Outcome 1 Implementation Period: Jul 01, 2020 - Jun 30, 2023

description.narrative:
Action 1: The MOP will establish the liquidity injection scheme to convert the outstanding payments of DISCOMs to generation companies totaling ₹1,200 billion to long-term loans extended by the PFCb against their pending receivables. The DISCOMs will use the first tranche of loan proceeds disbursed by the PFC to settle the outstanding payment of ₹450 billion owed to generators. Target date: 2023-06-30
Action 2: The MOP will notify the policy guidelines for the Reform-based and Results- linked Revamped Distribution Sector Scheme including the institutional reforms to be undertaken by participating DISCOMs with a central government funding allocation of ₹1,120 billion to be implemented over FY2022-FY2026 Target date: 2023-06-30
Action 3: The MOP will notify the increased coverage of payment security mechanism to ensure timely payment to generators by DISCOMs. Target date: 2023-06-30
